changes.description: When remembered user logs out, their vault meta data is no longer cleared.
Cognito credentials are no longer stored in local storage, they are ephemeral.
Issue with multiple remembered users not being handled correctly.
Huge refactor job on entire portal codebase. Should be transparent upgrade to user, but will enable future enhancements.
Portal version is now manually updated, this allows for transparent updates with change logging.
PWA Version link now brings up changes dialog with update button (if available).
Changes dialog which enumerates changes.json at runtime.
